set.body:
Problem: scalafim.model-build v1 (ModelBuildSpecJsonCodec.scala:270-318) carries formula, baseline, strategy, contrasts and nuisance matrices, but omits ConfoundSpec (separate codec, ConfoundDesign.scala:62), run combination (ModelJsonCodec.encodeRunCombination), derived columns (encodeDerivedColumns) and non-default FitControls, which it refuses (:117-124). Per-cell/phase HRFs and non-SPMG1 defaults are also refused. Only the event formula has a text form (FormulaPrinter.scala:140-186); baseline, confounds, censoring, noise model, run combination and LSA/LSS have none.

Consumer need: the studio saves and reopens one model and shows it as text (spec sections 2.5-2.6, 4.3-4.4; G16, G23, G40).

Acceptance:
- One strict, versioned envelope carrying every portable piece (formula, derived declarations, build spec incl. FitControls, ConfoundSpec, run combination); byte-identical round trip on JVM and JS; unknown or missing fields fail with a JSON path.
- Optional canonical text lines for baseline, confounds/censoring and estimation that re-parse to the same envelope.
- Existing model-spec/model-build v1 documents still decode.

Out of scope: executable callbacks; caller-supplied hrfFuns.
Provenance: verified read-only 2026-10-08 against ScalaFIM main ea6fe3ad for the PLS Neuro model studio (plsneuro review bd-01M4DMGP1QFSQX9Z5V91B4B12F; spec docs/plans/2026-10-02-model-studio-spec.md and GRAMMAR-NEEDS.md on plsneuro main).
set.title: Versioned model document binding formula, derived columns, build spec, confounds and run combination
